items.html: Now the Keter was corrected above, in the head, in the secret of the thirteen corrections of the skull, as above. And after them, the Hochma, which is the hidden Mocha, was corrected in its thirteen corrections, below them, at their end, which is beneath the forehead, within which are the brains, and beneath the corners of the head, as was said, for the Hochma is below the Keter.
